notes.title: Happy New Year
notes.content: We have added the Chinese New Year element to helmets and other models in the game. The volume setting is updated, and several bugs are fixed. Thanks to the support of our sponsor, we have also decorated the dressing room with music and video. Stay tuned for more updates!
